active_scientific_wave.name: controlled rotation field geometry and optical-field topography
active_scientific_wave.purpose: Diagnose the field-coordinate bridge from measured RAW source support into a free optical-field representation without promoting appearance geometry as physical sensor truth.

interpretation: Residual rotation alone does not change the current 12-sector mapping.
Scale and translation can change hard field-cell assignments.
Full residual similarity strongly lowers training RMSE but worsens the independent 270-degree hold-out.
The current weak link is the source-field to frontside coordinate bridge and coarse re-binning, not evidence that the measured rotation relation itself is physically wrong.

measured_support_bridge.support_cell_mapping: same radial/azimuth field bins as measured field signal

permanent_laws: Seal the evidence, not the thinking.
Representation can exceed the source. Knowledge claims cannot exceed the evidence.
Camera/lens/vendor/RAW identity may route decoding but may not select scientific truth.
Held-out values may evaluate a candidate but may not fit or select it.
Scientific Master writeback from this research wave is forbidden.
A topographic height is an observable axis only unless physical depth or literal lens curvature is separately proven.

next_test.export: Free World Observation Geometry Foundation v0.1 JSON
next_test.goal: Determine whether topographic ridges/basins in support geometry or nominal residuals explain the training-versus-held-out behavior without promoting a correction.

research_workbench_resilience_fix.latest_observed_device_failure: Foreground analysis service disappeared after about 30:50 while four RAW handles survived; prior Foundation save also produced a 0-byte destination after document-picker lifecycle loss.
confirmed_code_failure_modes: The first resilience pass persisted RAW handles but the UniversalSourceProfiler worker still belonged to MainActivity rather than the foreground service.
Completed full UniversalSourceProfile JSON objects could accumulate in Activity/process heap during long multi-RAW profiling.
ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT creates the destination before MainActivity returns; the old Foundation result path rebuilt the full report after the picker, so interruption could leave a 0-byte document.
Research relation records had a session id that could be lost on a cold process restart even when the records themselves still existed.
changes: TruthRawMediaProcessingForegroundService now owns the multi-RAW UniversalSourceProfiler batch and returns START_REDELIVER_INTENT for that research action.
Each completed derived UniversalSourceProfile is persisted independently; restarted service runs reuse completed profiles and redo only unfinished RAWs.
The service does not retain the complete multi-observation profile set while processing and forces a GC checkpoint between newly completed RAWs to reduce peak heap.
MainActivity polls persisted operation state while foregrounded and reloads completed profile JSON only after the service batch is terminal.
Research notification returns directly to the Research workbench.

Research JSON exports are frozen to a private payload file before ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT, SHA-256/byte-length validated, then streamed exactly to the chosen destination without rebuilding the Foundation after the picker.
The active research Calibration Observation Record session pointer is persisted durably and can migrate the latest valid legacy cache session after app restart.
research_workbench_resilience_fix.gpu_reason: Current failure is lifecycle/heap/export orchestration. Hashing, TIFF/DNG parsing, CFA statistics and JSON assembly are not suitable for a blind GPU migration, and authoritative numerical paths should keep deterministic CPU parity. GPU remains eligible later for separately validated APPEARANCE_DERIVED_ONLY kernels.
